decision_conditions: <p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">The proposed enlarged part of the dwellinghouse w</span><span style="text-align: justify;">ould have more than a single storey&nbsp;</span><span arial="" style="text-align: justify;">and would extend beyond the rear wall of the original dwellinghouse by more than 3 metres and is therefore&nbsp;</span><span pt="" sans="" style="text-align: justify;">not within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A.1 (h) (i) and (ja) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt; text-align:justify"><span arial="">The proposed enlarged part of the dwellinghouse would be within 2 metres of the boundary of the curtilage of the dwellinghouse, and the height of the eaves of the enlarged part would exceed 3 metres and is therefore </span><span pt="" sans="">not within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A.1 (i) and (ja) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span></p>
<p>The proposal is therefore not a lawful development.</p>

<p>It has not been demonstrated that the height of the porch would be less&nbsp;than 3 &nbsp;metres above ground level and the existing ground area of the porch exceeds 3 square metres&nbsp;<span arial="">and is therefore </span><span pt="" sans="">not within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class D, D.1&nbsp;(b) (c)&nbsp;of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span><br></p>
description: CERTIFICATE OF LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT(PROPOSED): Single and two storey rear extension; alterations to rear incorporating installation of doors; alterations to front porch
